He lit the lamp early that night, all three windows blazing.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像一台刚刚停转的机器，还留着余温。路灯把柏油路照成一条发白的河，洒水车从远处驶过，水声很轻。早点铺的卷帘门升起一半，蒸笼的白气挤出来，混着冷空气。送奶的三轮车、扫街人的扫帚、便利店里打哈欠的店员，构成了这个时刻全部的声音。写字楼仍有几扇窗亮着，像没能闭上的眼睛。天边泛起一点灰蓝，鸟先于人醒来。城市在这一刻既不属于昨天，也还没交给今天。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a problem by asking a smaller copy of itself for help.\n- Imagine standing in a line and wanting to know your place: you ask the person ahead of you, they ask the person ahead of them, until the very first person says \"I'm number one!\" — then the answers come back down the line, each adding one.\n- Every recursion needs a stopping point (like the first person in line), or it would keep asking forever."}
